solution_designs.state_model: Single inheritance plus subclass-owned fields.
representation: parent arguments go through the parent constructor
subclass-only fields initialise afterward
super/parent call occurs exactly once
preconditions: Parent constructor and subclass table are known.
postconditions: Every input parameter is consumed exactly once and all parent/subclass invariants hold.
Exact source return/output and identifier obligations remain part-specific.
invariants: Every constructor parameter has exactly one destination: parent constructor or subclass field.
Every subclass instance is substitutable where the cited parent interface is expected.
After the parent call, all inherited fields satisfy the parent invariant.
Parent invariant and every subclass-only field invariant hold simultaneously.
Every input parameter is consumed exactly once and all parent/subclass invariants hold.
mutation_and_preservation_rules: No unrequested state mutation.
Every successful mutation restores class/object invariant before return.
Private identifier spelling and object identity remain explicit state facts.
solution_designs.termination_argument: verifies_subclass_contract: After construction design.
failure_paths: Inherited fields and method dispatch are absent.
The parent invariant fails or a parameter is consumed twice.
Subclass/update may create a field/method different from the caller contract.
alternative_designs: parent arguments go through the parent constructor

boundary: no optional new field if source has none
counterexample: wrong super order
parent field assigned twice

input_contract.vi: Object hợp lệ cùng replacement value/index nếu có.
input_contract.en: A valid object and replacement value/optional index.

output_contract.vi: Đúng target được thay; state không liên quan được giữ nguyên.
output_contract.en: Exact target replacement; unrelated state preserved.

solution_designs.state_model: Single direct instance-member assignment.
representation: field_after equals parameter
no relative arithmetic or clamp
parameter/index order remains source-specific
preconditions: Target member and direct replacement value are known.
postconditions: Target replacement holds; unrelated state and required interface remain unchanged.
Exact source return/output and identifier obligations remain part-specific.
invariants: Post-field equals the supplied value exactly unless the QP explicitly says otherwise.
Each parameter has one source role and one target role.
Only the target member changes and its post-value equals the parameter.
Target replacement holds; unrelated state and required interface remain unchanged.
mutation_and_preservation_rules: No unrequested state mutation.
Every successful mutation restores class/object invariant before return.
Private identifier spelling and object identity remain explicit state facts.
solution_designs.termination_argument: verifies_setter: After assignment.
failure_paths: The post-value differs from the direct input.
The wrong member changes even though the method runs.
The interface differs from the QP and caller assumptions.

counterexample: add instead of replace
swapped value/index

input_contract.en: The source fixes the file record schema, constructor/subclass or lookup-update contract, destination capacity/count, termination and file-error behavior.

output_contract.vi: Kết quả/trạng thái phải thỏa: Mỗi record thành công tạo đúng một object hợp lệ hoặc cập nhật đúng một target; partial object không vào destination state.
output_contract.en: Result/state satisfies: Each successful record produces exactly one correctly typed source-permitted object creation or one update to the uniquely matched object; no partial object enters destination state.

solution_designs.state_model: A complete typed record buffer mapped to one object constructor/subclass or to one located existing object, followed by a single object commit/update.
representation: A complete typed record buffer mapped to one object constructor/subclass or to one located existing object, followed by a single object commit/update.
preconditions: The source fixes the file record schema, constructor/subclass or lookup-update contract, destination capacity/count, termination and file-error behavior.
postconditions: Each successful record produces exactly one correctly typed source-permitted object creation or one update to the uniquely matched object; no partial object enters destination state.
invariants: Each successful record produces exactly one correctly typed source-permitted object creation or one update to the uniquely matched object; no partial object enters destination state.
mutation_and_preservation_rules: Only the commit step may change learner-visible state; rejected/failure paths preserve prior valid state.
solution_designs.termination_argument: Termination follows the explicit role `terminates_read_objects` and its stated guard/check.
failure_paths: Reading the wrong number of lines per record so a later field shifts into the previous record.
Selecting the wrong subclass/key or constructing before conversion/lookup completes.

normal: group fixed lines and construct one object in exact parameter order
boundary: a record key locates one existing object and changes source-stated fields
